description: Converts a note voltage into the control voltage that selects patterns 1 to 99 on docB's HexSeqP2 sequencer

inputs.text: The note that picks the pattern, read over C1 to D#9; anything outside that span is held at its nearer end, and unpatched the module reads C1

outputs.text: A voltage from 0V to 9.9V in steps of 0.1V, one step per semitone, which selects the pattern number on HexSeqP2

inputs.0:
-3 to 5.25V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads -3V.
